label: $SERVICE_NAME for $ARCH
description: LLM-based workload monitoring service. Discovers Open Horizon workloads via the anax API, monitors the logs of workloads that opt in, and generates remediation proposals for detected errors.

userInput.name: MONITOR_ANAX_URL
userInput.label: Base URL of the local Open Horizon agent (anax) API

userInput.name: MONITOR_LLM_MODEL
userInput.label: Ollama model used for error analysis

userInput.name: MONITOR_LLM_TIMEOUT
userInput.label: Seconds before an LLM analysis request is cancelled

userInput.name: MONITOR_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE
userInput.label: Maximum pending analysis requests before shedding low-severity work

userInput.name: MONITOR_MAX_BUFFER_MB
userInput.label: Maximum in-memory log buffer in megabytes

userInput.name: MONITOR_PROPOSAL_DIR
userInput.label: Directory where remediation proposals are written

userInput.name: MONITOR_LOG_LEVEL
userInput.label: Logging verbosity (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)
